segments.en: I work in a bank, what about you?
Oh my god, I work in Jana Small Finance Bank.
No, the work is not done, it's done. Is yours done?
Yes, I am on leave today. What about you?
What to tell? How is work going? Life, everything?
Okay, is your family married there?
I asked if you were married.
Why are you asking? You are married, right?
My hometown is in Andhra, I am an area manager here.
No, I have rented a room. I used to work in my hometown, then I got transferred here with a promotion.
What else is good for bankers?
Yes, Saturday, Sunday, Monday, three days leave.
Same for me, I am going to my hometown tomorrow.
How many days has it been since you started using this?
I came yesterday. I was alone in Bangalore, so I came here to find friends.
I have been in Bangalore for a month.
Actually, it's a new place, right?
Yes, don't worry, don't stress. Bangalore is very good. Everyone adjusts here.
How long have you been here?
I have been in Bangalore for three years.
What did you do for the weekend?
It should be set, we have to set it ourselves.
No, you know, in Bangalore PGs, there are mostly Andhra PGs. Food will be adjusted.
Andhra, Andhra means mine is not Andhra, it's on the Karnataka border.
When I first came to Bangalore, I was near Kolar. There is an iPhone manufacturing company in Narasapura, right?
It was Wistron then, now it's Tata.
Okay, how many days did you work there?
No, I worked there for 10 months. It was very difficult, there were no leaves, and I couldn't even give it to anyone else.
I was stuck there, then I left.
Then I came to Bangalore and stayed in a PG for a week.
Oh, gold loan, okay. Is it cash or sales?
Sales, sales. I used to do operations before, they put a lot of pressure, so I have to do sales and look after operations.
That's why I jumped to sales. I have been here for six months.
Incentives come, but it's difficult. I do gold loans.
Gold loan, it depends on the location. Koramangala is a government area, right?
Family misses, what to do? I have to do it for work.
Have you gone since you came?
Have you gone to your hometown since you came to Bangalore?
No, I will go. I have kept my car, whenever I get time, I will go.
I don't go by train, it gets too late, so I go by car.
It's nearby, you can go and come back. K.R. Puram, right? If it was on this side, it would be a bit difficult.
You can go from there, no problem.
Are you going to your hometown tomorrow?
Yes, tomorrow, tomorrow there is no leave, I will take half-day permission and go.
Monday is a festival in our hometown, Panchami is also on the same day, so I won't come on Monday.
Tuesday or Wednesday I should come, I have decided. I need leave, it's been a month, I haven't gone to my hometown.
So I am missing it, I need leave.
Here, on weekends, where do you go? What do you do? Do you have friends?
There is no one like that. I used to go every 15 days.
But this last month, activities, this and that, I couldn't go even in my leave time.
I wasn't well either, so I didn't go. Second Saturday, fourth Saturday, I normally go to my hometown.
But this time I didn't go anywhere. I was just in the PG, if I went, it was to the office or to the store.
Same here, the problem is the same.
It's like, if you go to the office, you have to go somewhere. In the morning, they take an hour to get ready.
I asked who takes the gold loan.
Gold loan, our team takes it. The branch manager takes it. Our branch banking is done.
On this side, they also take it. On that side, our gold team also takes it. Target is not there, but complete target is not asked, poor people, they are good.
They don't just bring it and keep it. They have to work hard. In our branch, they don't understand how to play, you know?
Today is a holiday, I don't know anything, today is a holiday, they say. When I say that, I just get up and come.
Where can I bring it from? You tell me.
For that, they say, okay, I will do it, they say. Follow-up is there, you know, the worst of the worst.
They say they will come here, one hour is enough, right? If you go to any bank, any industry, they will finish it in 20 to 30 minutes, maximum one hour, understand?
They ask here, I will come, okay, like this, like that, they all say. One week, one month, I have been following up.
Madam, I will come today, or tomorrow morning, I will come, madam, I have an emergency, like this, like that, they say. If I call, they don't respond to the phone.

After a few days, I get to know, no madam, there, the interest is low, and they know others, we haven't paid the interest, even then, gold won't be auctioned, yours is not in our hands, madam, like this, like that, they say.
What to do? They don't even listen, they say they will come, they will come, and at the last minute, they raise their hands.
It's difficult, gold loan, it's not that good, but what to do? Activation is done, then no one listens.
A little bit, they give a gap to breathe.
If it's something else, then, if we go to clarity, we have to do all the products.
You, I mean, in which one did you do it? Which department?
For that customer, I have to follow up.
That's a bit of an irritation, right?
Oh, here, our supervisor is there, they do it like this, you know, I mean, another branch manager.
They are in collection, the branch head.
They sometimes, I mean, starting, their branch training was done, they were there, right?
I am a little bit of a small girl, so they talk nicely.
They call and say, I will give you a number.
